<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

The `daily_yield` sensor has no `device_class` or `state_class` provided. 
On the other end, the `total_yield` does.
I think this is why you can't use this sensor for statistics.
Thanks guys, I added the required attributes via the config. Didnt know you can change the integration sensors like that!
